name: Zalo
author: hgrave
description: Zalo Web in the Omarchy bar: unread badge, one click to open or focus Zalo as a Chrome/Brave web app (with your profile's extensions, e.g. auto-translate), and a popup with quick actions and recent messages.

barWidget.description: Unread badge for Zalo Web. Click to open or focus Zalo, right-click for recent messages and actions, middle-click to mark read.

schema.label: Browser
schema.description: Zalo opens as an app window in this browser, so extensions installed there (such as an auto-translate extension) run inside Zalo.

schema.label: Browser profile directory
schema.description: Optional, e.g. "Default" or "Profile 1" — the profile that has your extensions. Empty uses the browser's last-used profile.

schema.label: Left click
schema.description: Right click does the other one.

schema.label: Show unread count (off shows a dot)
Show message previews in the panel
